payload.text: kovacs is to be a pristine brew-only install for Utilz and Intent: hv's ruling of 19 Oct, relayed to vc by kovacs-sysadm. No permanent dev checkout there and no link from a PATH dir into one. ~/Devel/prj/Utilz on kovacs and its 16 ~/bin links are leftovers, which hv has put off removing, so nothing may depend on them, nor be added beside them. A kovacs test leg lives in its own /var/tmp run dir, pip's cache included, and is removed once its logs are back; it ships its own tree rather than basing a bundle on the leftover checkout. Utilz is brew-installed there from 2.14.1, which drops depends_on :macos (decision 32); until the tap has it, nothing installs Utilz on kovacs.
